_readme: Pre-existing API drift, recorded so the gate can fail on NEW drift. This is a debt ledger: it must only ever shrink. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-api-drift.mjs --update-baseline` — and only to REMOVE entries you have fixed, never to bless new ones.

_fields.missing_route: METHOD /api/path the SPA calls with no worker route at all.
_fields.missing_method: Path exists on the worker but not for that HTTP method.
_fields.error_envelope: file:line (status) — a >=400 c.json() with no error/detail/message key, so the SPA's request() helper can only surface "Request failed".
